Security Coordinator '''Michyl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a social items vendor on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She wore a [[Color/Legends|tan]] [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] and had brown hair and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].
